rules.condition: for every legal value of PARA_UART_CLKS_PER_BIT
rules.statement: The block shall meet timing at 50 MHz (20 ns period) on GF180MCU for every legal value of PARA_UART_CLKS_PER_BIT.
The RTL shall be synthesizable, contain no latches and pass Verilator lint with no warnings.
All flip-flops shall use the asynchronous active-low reset i_rst_n.
The two i_rxd synchronizer flip-flops should be marked so synthesis does not merge, duplicate or retime them.
The bit-period counters should be only as wide as PARA_UART_CLKS_PER_BIT needs, at most 16 bits.
The block should use only the storage the specification requires: transmit shift register, receive shift register, holding register, counters and flags.
